Chapter 6504: Die

Chapter 6504: Die

Seventy-two went mad and no longer had any reservations. He had one thought alone - turning Li Qiye to ashes using the immortal flame.

He didn’t mind burying his sect’s members and worldly energy, let alone Trinity or Immortal Gate. Keep in mind that among the victims were his descendants and loved ones. Of course, since he was willing to die, other lives were an acceptable price.

Screams didn’t stop from the victims of the three dao lineages until they turned into dried corpses.

“Not like this...” Bronze Ancestor couldn’t enter the sect to stop the momentum. He was only an earth ancestor and could only watch in despair.

All the big shots in Old World turned pale at this sight. Some dropped to the ground, realizing the fragility of lives. Just a moment ago, the victims offered their strength to help their primal ancestors.

“So evil.” Everyone despised Seventy-two.

“Not worthy of being an ancestor.” Ocean-gaze and his allies shook their head.

They fought fiercely in the past, crushing one kingdom after another. However, sacrificing one’s own sect like this was unacceptable.

“His dao heart is ruined, he’s fallen.” North Kun said.

Such a devious act had nothing to do with external matters. Seventy-two himself fell to his heart devil and chose the darkness, carrying out the heinous act.

Once he absorbed enough vitality and energy, his cracked body stabilized again and glowed magnificently.

“Boom!” He became tougher than ever before, able to endure more from the two realms. He stood at the apex, feeling like an immortal and more confident than ever before.

“I will flay you!” His eyes had a dreadful bloody glow.

“How pitiful, just a stubborn child ruining your parents’ honorable reputation.” Li Qiye uttered coldly.

“I’m pitiful? I will destroy you, Desolate Frontier, and all of Old World. I will bury everyone and damn them eternally.” Seventy-two shouted.

“Is that so?” Li Qiye’s brows furrowed after hearing the threat.

“Die! This whole world will cease to exist.” Seventy-two aimed the tube at Desolate Frontier.

“Shit!” North Kun, Whale, and Alch-deer were horrified.

The grand momentum of Desolate Frontier sensed a threat and automatically activated its barriers. Laws intertwined to form a supreme chapter serving as a shield.

No lineage in Old World could compare due to its founder’s greatness. Normally, the barriers weren’t needed but they were fully activated this time.

Seventy-two wanted to destroy all of Old World - a thought he had harbored since youth due to suffering and humiliation.

Since he didn’t have the ability, this thought never received the proper spark. Now, he wielded the flame of a true immortal and this destructive thought roamed free.
